The study investigates a polyacrylamide‑titanium dioxide (PAA@TiO₂) nanocomposite as an adsorbent for crystal violet, reporting adsorption capacities, characterization, and molecular‑level interaction energies. None of the four candidate hypotheses describe this specific polymer‑inorganic nanocomposite or its described synthesis and testing conditions. Therefore, the evidence does not support any of the listed hypotheses.

CHOICE: NONE
